what_to_detect: A permanent spell cast with disturb resolves: its zone_change to the battlefield puts the card there back face up.
near_miss: A double-faced permanent spell cast for its mana cost resolves onto the battlefield front face up.
record_fields: card face_state (gen-3, in the next record's snapshot)
note: Forge casts a disturb spell with its back state already set, so no face_change event is expected when it enters; outcome_event cannot read the entering card's face or the cost it was cast with.
